teaser: This issue's twelve papers center on workforce and education, with five papers covering nursing informatics competencies, simulation training, AI in nursing practice education, workforce management tools, and pharmacy education. A second thread looks at patient-facing AI tools, including a gastric cancer education chatbot and an AI telephone follow-up system, both compared against human-delivered care. Clinical decision support appears twice, covering a dysphagia screening model and a decision mining tool for quality improvement. NLP and generative AI also appear twice, applied to quality-of-life narratives and rheumatoid arthritis literature, while one paper validates a Chinese-language AI ethics awareness scale.

themes.name: AI tools compared to human performance
